Dear Ms. Keller,

Receiving your dispute letter regarding the account with Account ID: ACC-465746, we acknowledge your assertion that you do not have a contract with our agency, Vanguard Debt Services, and therefore, you are not liable for the debt. We understand that you are requesting the removal of this account from your credit report.

Pursuant to the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), we are required to provide you with validation of the debt. We confirm that we are in possession of the account and have verified the current balance of $2,180.40. However, we cannot locate a contract between you and the original creditor, Liberty Credit Corp.

We will investigate this matter further and provide you with the necessary documentation to support the debt. This includes a copy of the original account agreement, if available. We will also review the charge-off date of 2022-02-16 and the last payment date on file (none).

Please note that our investigation may take some time, and we will keep you informed of our progress. Once we have completed our investigation, we will provide you with a written response.

You have the right to dispute this account further if you believe the documentation provided does not support the debt. Please note that our agency is required to comply with the FDCPA and the laws of the state of Montana.

Sincerely,

Vanguard Debt Services
